filter_note: V1 set (7) + market briefing + AI news; Today window = Thu Oct 22 – Fri Oct 23 PT

market_briefing.lede: Agent skills are becoming shared infrastructure, while the systems agents act on are tightening who gets in. Anthropic handed the Agent Skills standard to a neutral foundation, and US banks began restricting third-party agents they cannot verify inside customer accounts.

bullets.text: Skills move to neutral governance: on Oct 22 Anthropic donated Agent Skills (the SKILL.md folder format) to the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation, home of MCP. It says 70+ agent platforms including ChatGPT, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and VS Code support it, with 1 million skills published and nearly 280 million installed. First roadmap: versioned releases, a formal proposal process and security guidance for people who write and install skills.

Systems of record push back on unverified agents: Axios reported Oct 22 that major US banks are detecting unauthorized third-party AI agents inside customer accounts, some acting beyond user instructions, and are restricting access because they struggle to tell agents from people or confirm the customer authorized them.

Approval prompts give way to automated checks: Claude said Oct 22 that starting next week its web, desktop and mobile apps will run in auto mode by default on Pro, Max and Team, with an automated check blocking risky actions instead of asking at each step.

biggest_ai_news.title: Full Claude Platform goes GA on Google Cloud, run by Anthropic
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 22: an Anthropic-managed option on Google Cloud with Google IAM, billing and commitment drawdown, and new Claude features on the day they ship (Managed Agents beta, skills, code execution, MCP connector). Anthropic is the data processor; the Google-managed option remains for residency and native Google tooling.

biggest_ai_news.title: OpenAI makes the Decisions API generally available
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 22: a dedicated endpoint on GPT-6 Luna for bounded classification, routing and scoring calls inside apps and agents. Up to 400 questions per request, $0.10 per million input tokens and no output-token charge; OpenAI claims up to 10x faster than the same model via the Responses API (company figure).

biggest_ai_news.title: OpenAI reportedly nears up to $30B at a $1.25T valuation
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 22 (reported, not confirmed by OpenAI): CNBC says UAE investors and Coatue lead a round of up to $30B at a $1.25T pre-money valuation, framed as a bridge ahead of a possible IPO; terms could change.

what_changed.title: Salesforce ships Marketing Cloud agents and a headless MCP path
what_changed.body: NEW (watchlist release). Oct 22: Marketing Cloud Winter '27 lists Account Discovery Agent, which reads CRM data to show who on an account's buying committee is engaging or going dark, for sales and marketing (GA October '26); Campaign Agent for goal-driven campaigns (GA now); and Headless Marketing, which lets ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Slack and other agents run campaigns and Data 360 pipelines through the Headless 360 MCP Server (GA October '26).

what_changed.title: Monaco publishes Agent Matrix docs naming its agents
what_changed.body: UPDATE (follow-up to Oct 21 launch). Monaco's help-center article (last updated Oct 22) lists seven ready-made agents: Lookalikes, Re-engagement, Inbound Qualification, Meeting Prep, Tasks, Pipeline Review and Product Feedback. Re-engagement (Monday drafts for quiet conversations) and Meeting Prep are already on for every account. Custom agents are described in chat and run on a schedule or trigger, with an approve-first option. Lookalikes and Inbound Qualification are set up with a Monaco FDAE. No pricing.

what_changed.title: Clay teams with SpaceXAI to run Grok Bot inside Clay
what_changed.body: NEW (watchlist, soft). Oct 23: Clay says it is collaborating with SpaceXAI so Grok Bot can build Clay workflows from natural language, research companies, enrich contacts and draft emails for rep review; a build session is set for Oct 29. Announcement only; no integration docs yet.

what_changed.title: Agent Skills standard moves to the Agentic AI Foundation
what_changed.body: NEW (category). Oct 22: Anthropic donated Agent Skills to AAIF; the foundation added OpenAI's Open Responses, Hugging Face's OpenEnv and Alibaba's OpenSandbox the same day.

what_changed.title: Dapta raises $6M for AI sales agents priced per qualified meeting
what_changed.body: NEW (category). Oct 22: Colombian startup Dapta raised a $6M seed led by Chingona Ventures for Spanish-language sales agents that handle lead response, qualification and scheduling. Its Dapti agent charges per qualified meeting; it reports $4M ARR (company figure).

quiet_note: No first-party news Oct 22–23 from Gong (Gartner MQ Oct 16 still top of press), Outreach (October release notes Oct 8), Salesloft (last newsroom item Oct 6) or Nooks. Not new: Salesforce Service Cloud Europe/Casey coverage on Oct 22 restates the Oct 13 blog; Slack Frontline is Oct 19. Salesforce Agent Optimizer / AI Skills GA and the per-call agent rate are still unconfirmed. Aged off Today: Monaco Agent Matrix launch, Clay GTM CI/CD, Zoom Unified Context Layer, OpenAI router policy, Anthropic user profiles, Claude Duet (covered Oct 22).

watch.title: Whether Salesforce's October GA promises land by Oct 31
watch.body: Account Discovery Agent and Headless Marketing are dated GA October '26, alongside the still-unconfirmed Agent Optimizer / AI Skills GA and the per-call agent rate. Watch release notes and pricing pages for which actually ship this month and whether MCP access to Marketing Cloud carries its own metering.

interpretation.fact: Salesforce published Marketing Cloud Winter '27 agents and Headless Marketing (Oct 22). Monaco's Agent Matrix help article lists seven agents (updated Oct 22). Clay announced a SpaceXAI / Grok Bot collaboration (Oct 23). Anthropic donated Agent Skills to AAIF (Oct 22). Axios reported banks restricting third-party agents (Oct 22). Claude Platform on Google Cloud (Anthropic-managed) and OpenAI's Decisions API went GA (Oct 22). CNBC reported OpenAI's ~$30B raise (Oct 22). Dapta raised $6M (Oct 22).
interpretation.note: Light interpretation: with skills and MCP becoming neutral, portable standards, a GTM agent's edge shifts to the data and permissions it can reach. Salesforce is opening Marketing Cloud to outside agents on its own terms, while banks show that systems of record will block agents that cannot prove who authorized them.
